name: Consolidated Edison (CECONY)
territory: New York City and Westchester County
_dc_note: NYC data centre load estimated ~1,500 MW (2026). dc_load_growth_rate calibrated to 6%/yr (down from an initially-proposed 12%/yr, which compounds to a 5.0% total-peak CAGR over 24 years — roughly double Con Edison's published load growth forecast). At 6%/yr, combined with BASELINE_LOAD_GROWTH (0.5%) and ELECTRIFICATION_RAMP, total peak CAGR is 2.4% and BAU 2050 monthly bill is ~$426 — both consistent with Con Edison's published load growth forecast and with pre-segmentation model results (~$424). NYISO large load project requests show a significant data centre pipeline for NYC/Westchester supporting continued growth at this segment-specific rate. Source: Con Edison 2025 DSIP; NYISO 2025 reliability needs assessment.
_sources: Rate base & capital: Joint Proposal, NYPSC Case 25-E-0072, approved January 22 2026 (annual_capex_m = average of RY1 $4,550M / RY2 $4,474M / RY3 $4,712M; total_revenue_m estimated). ROE and equity_ratio: Joint Proposal 2026-2028. Customers, peak_demand_mw, annual_energy_gwh: Con Edison 2024 Form 10-K. DER baseline: CLCPA progress reports; NYSERDA data.
_notes: capacity_market / capacity_market_zone are descriptive metadata pointing to shared/capacity_markets/NYISO.json; not yet consumed by the model engine at this refactoring stage — CAPACITY_COST_START remains a notebook-level global.
